# Stanford Health Care

> > Stanford Health Care provides world-class medical services across the San Francisco Bay Area with specialized clinics, advanced treatment programs, and comprehensive patient care.

Stanford Health Care operates multiple specialty clinics throughout Northern California, including locations in Redwood City, San Jose, Livermore, Fresno, and Emeryville. The health system offers advanced treatment programs ranging from facial pain management and lung disease care to ophthalmology, orthopedics, cancer treatment, and gender-affirming surgery, supported by the MyHealth patient portal and community partnerships.

## Key Topics

- MyHealth patient portal
- Facial Pain Program
- Center for Advanced Lung Disease
- Byers Eye Institute
- Retina and Macular Diseases
- Cancer Center services
- Orthopedics and Sports Medicine
- ValleyCare joint replacement
- Gender-affirming surgery

- Redwood City location
- Livermore location

## Specialty Medical Clinics

- [Facial Pain Program in Redwood City](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/facial-pain-program-redwood-city.html): Facial Pain Program in Redwood City with CyberKnife & pain management
- [Facial Pain Program at 801 Welch Road](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/facial-pain-program-801-welch-road.html): Facial Pain Program at 801 Welch Road location with specialty treatment
- [Center for Advanced Lung Disease in Fresno](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/center-advanced-lung-disease-fresno.html): Center for Advanced Lung Disease in Fresno specializing in transplants
- [Chest Clinic](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/pulmonology/research.html): Chest Clinic offering pulmonology care & research for lung diseases
- [General Cardiology in Emeryville](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/general-cardiology-emeryville.html): General Cardiology clinic in Emeryville for cardiovascular care
- [Orthopaedics and Sports Medicine in Redwood City](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/orthopaedics-sports-medicine-redwood-city.html): Orthopaedics & Sports Medicine clinic in Redwood City for musculoskeletal care

## Eye Care and Ophthalmology

- [Byers Eye Institute in Livermore](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/byers-eye-institute-livermore.html): Byers Eye Institute in Livermore offering ophthalmology services
- [Retina and Macular Diseases Clinic in Livermore](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/retina-and-macular-diseases-clinic-in-livermore.html): Retina & Macular Diseases Clinic in Livermore for eye care treatment

## Cancer and Surgical Services

- [Contacts & Locations](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/cancer-center-contact-us.html): Cancer Center contact information & location details
- [Breast Reconstruction Clinic in San Jose](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/breast-reconstruction-san-jose.html): Breast Reconstruction Clinic in San Jose for plastic surgery services
- [Gender-Affirming Facial Plastic Surgery in San Jose](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/gender-affirming-facial-plastic-surgery-san-jose.html): Gender-affirming facial plastic surgery in San Jose for transgender care

## Patient Services and Resources

- [Find a Doctor](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/valleycare-joint-replacement-expertise-treatment/find-a-doctor.html): Find orthopedic surgeons for ValleyCare joint replacement services
- [Blood Draw at Stanford Cancer Center](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/medical-clinics/blood-draw-sites/locations/cancer-center-lab.html): Walk-in blood draw lab services at Stanford Cancer Center location
- [Understanding AFib and Stroke Prevention](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/afib-guide.html): Patient guide for atrial fibrillation & stroke prevention strategies

## Community Partnerships and Programs

- [Total Health Collaborative, Samaritan House](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/about-us/community-partnerships/community-partnerships-and-offerings/total-health-collaborative.html): Total Health Collaborative partnership with Samaritan House free clinic
- [Access to Surgical Services and Specialty Care, Operation Access](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/about-us/community-partnerships/community-partnerships-and-offerings/access-to-surgical-services.html): Operation Access partnership providing surgical care for uninsured patients
- [Ride Smart. Wear a Helmet.](https://stanfordhealthcare.org/campaigns/helmet-safety.html): Helmet safety campaign for injury prevention & cycling protection
